user.title: Shady
user.description:
Corrected solar forecast as HA sensors.

Correction is computed via linear regression (with ±1h neighbour smoothing at 50 % weight) over the last N days – separately for each configured PV string.

data.use_effective_sensors: Use loss-adjusted effective sensors for model correction
data.filter_recorder_gaps: Filter gap-successor samples from recorder data

data_description.algorithm: Algorithm used to compute the per-hour shading correction
data_description.import_sensors: Power entering the BMS (grid draw, battery discharge). Select one or more sensors. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.export_sensors: Power leaving the BMS (grid feed-in, battery charge). Select one or more sensors. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.use_effective_sensors: When enabled, the correction model uses the loss-adjusted effective PV sensor values instead of the raw PV sensors.
data_description.filter_recorder_gaps: When enabled, the first recorder sample after a downtime gap longer than one slot interval (5 min) is discarded. This prevents accumulated recorder values from skewing the correction model and effective-history backfill.
